Storage Box.name: Storage Box
Storage Box.flavorText: A convenient box you can store items in. It's made of wood and easy to move things in and out of.

Wall Storage Box.name: Wall Storage Box
Wall Storage Box.flavorText: It may be small, but it can store lots of stuff. Try mounting it on a wall

Big Storage Box.name: Big Storage Box
Big Storage Box.flavorText: Roughly three times bigger than your standard storage box. You can put a lot of things inside.

Polygonal Shelf.name: Polygonal Shelf
Polygonal Shelf.flavorText: A stylish, eye-catching shelf. Looks hard to use but still functions as a shelf just fine,

Cardboard Boxes.name: Cardboard Boxes
Cardboard Boxes.flavorText: Light cardboard boxes. It doesn't look like they have anything inside

Worn Wooden Crate.name: Worn Wooden Crate

Wooden Crate.name: Wooden Crate
Wooden Crate.flavorText: You have absolutely no idea how to open this box...But you can put stuff on top of it at least!

Cleaning Supplies.name: Cleaning Supplies

Shower.name: Shower

Water Basin.name: Water Basin
Water Basin.flavorText: Fill this with water so Pokémon can do some watering for you

Pokémetal.name: Pokémetal

Toy Blocks.name: Toy Blocks
Toy Blocks.flavorText: Stacking toys that are fun to play with. Discover all the different combinations you can make!

Sandbags.name: Sandbags
Sandbags.flavorText: A cloth sack filled with dirt and sand. It's pretty bulky and looks heavy

Metal Drum.name: Metal Drum
Metal Drum.flavorText: A smooth, clean canister. It's empty, so it's actually quite light

Construction Supplies.name: Construction Supplies
Construction Supplies.flavorText: Construction tools stored in a meta drum. Great for factories or warehouses.

Iron Pipes.name: Iron Pipes
Iron Pipes.flavorText: A pile of iron pipes that looks like it belongs at a construction site

Wheelbarrow.name: Wheelbarrow
Wheelbarrow.flavorText: A wheelbarrow carrying a large mound of dirt. A lot of construction sites probably have these!

Iron-scaffold Plank.name: Iron-scaffold Plank
Iron-scaffold Plank.flavorText: A plank that rests atop an iron scaffold. Try using it to extend the length of your scaffolding!

Iron Scaffold.name: Iron Scaffold
Iron Scaffold.flavorText: A sturdy scaffold used for constructing buildings. The plank's bumpy surface provides great tractions.

Plain Chest.name: Plain Chest
Plain Chest.flavorText: A chest with a simple design. It can be used to store items.

Office Cabinet.name: Office Cabinet
Office Cabinet.flavorText: Compacy furniture that's surprisingly spacious. Open the sliding door to put items inside

Poké Ball Chest.name: Poké Ball Chest
Poké Ball Chest.flavorText: This looks like a giant Poké Ball. It opens wide for you to store things inside

Berry Case.name: Berry Case
Berry Case.flavorText: At a glance, this looks just like a glossy Cheri Berry. It opens wide for you to store things inside

Antique Chest.name: Antique Chest
Antique Chest.flavorText: Its four curvy legs are adorable. Try putting lots of different things in the draw

Plain Closet.name: Plain Closet
Plain Closet.flavorText: Open the curtains and store your stuff! You don't actually need the hangers-but they're there anyway!

Office Locker.name: Office Locker
Office Locker.flavorText: A large locker that can even hold clothing. Try storing lots of different things in it!

Antique Closet.name: Antique Closet
Antique Closet.flavorText: A large bulky closet. Try storing different things in it!

Office Shelf.name: Office Shelf
Office Shelf.flavorText: This is jam-packed with so many files that it can't hold anything else

Mug.name: Mug
Mug.flavorText: A simple, easy-to-use mug. You could change up the colors, and it would still look great.

Munna Bank.name: Munna Bank
Munna Bank.flavorText: An especially heavy money box. It feels like it's full of coins

Garbage Bin.name: Garbage Bin
Garbage Bin.flavorText: This trash can is big enough that a Pokémon could probably fit inside!

Cute Table.name: Cute Table
Cute Table.flavorText: A table with cute lace and frills. It somehow reminds you of Fairy types

Pop Art Table.name: Pop Art Table
Pop Art Table.flavorText: A shiny, round table. It's as smooth as a Porygon2

Stylish Stool.name: Stylish Stool
Stylish Stool.flavorText: A small, round stool with a stylish three-color cushion.

Cute Chair.name: Cute Chair
Cute Chair.flavorText: The ruffle skirt is exceptionally cute and lovely

Pop Art Chair.name: Pop Art Chair
Pop Art Chair.flavorText: A chair with a soft design and rounded corners. The colors of the backrest and cushion can be changed

Cute Sofa.name: Cute Sofa
Cute Sofa.flavorText: A cute, slightly elegant sofa. The backrest is shaped like a Pokémon's wings.

Pop Art Sofa.name: Pop Art Sofa
Pop Art Sofa.flavorText: A soft-looking sofa with cute, rounded edges.

Pop Art Bed.name: Pop Art Bed
Pop Art Bed.flavorText: lying on tthis bed feels like being inside of a pod. It's soft, fluffy, and easy to sleep on.

Berry Bed.name: Berry Bed
Berry Bed.flavorText: A large Pecha Berry-themed bed. It's springy texture provides ultimate comfort at bedtime.

Cute Bed.name: Cute Bed
Cute Bed.flavorText: You'll feel like royalty sleeping on this cute canopy bed.

Cute Dresser.name: Cute Dresser
Cute Dresser.flavorText: Look into the mirror to change your transformation and perfect your look!

Eevee Doll.flavorText: If you set this down and inspect it, Drifloon may fly over and whisk you away to a Dream Island

Cute Lamp.flavorText: A cute decorative lamp, even when it's turned off. Power it on to make the central heart glow.

Pop Art Lamp.name: Pop Art Lamp
Pop Art Lamp.flavorText: The bright bulb bounces off a shiny lampshade. Looking at it seems to improve your mood!

Cute Flower.name: Cute Flower
Cute Flower.flavorText: Cute flowers that bloom in port towns. They would surely be a delightful gift to any Pokémon

Microwave Oven.name: Microwave Oven
Microwave Oven.flavorText: This lights up when powered on, but it doesn't seem like it can heat anything...

Refrigerator.name: Refrigerator
Refrigerator.flavorText: It emits a slight chill, but it doesn't seem like it can keep anything cold

Fan.name: Fan
Fan.flavorText: Power on this fan to make it swivel. Pokémon might stop by to watch it move

Air Conditioner.name: Air Conditioner
Air Conditioner.flavorText: A state-of-the-art air conditioner. Press once for cold air, or press twice for hot

Printer.name: Printer
Printer.flavorText: A large printer used by businesses. Perfect for an office or other workspaces!

Washing Machine.name: Washing Machine
Washing Machine.flavorText: While this does make noise when powered on, it doesn't seem to actually wash clothes...

Toilet.name: Toilet
Toilet.flavorText: Lift the cover and sit on the toilet for as long as you like

Tablet.name: Tablet
Tablet.flavorText: A convenient, easy-to-carry computer. It's got a hard case so no worries if you drop it!

Cell Phone.name: Cell Phone
Cell Phone.flavorText: A device carefully protected inside a hard case. It can't make calls, even when powered on

Laptop.name: Laptop
Laptop.flavorText: A sleek, easy-to-carry laptop. Try displaying some photos on the monitor.

Computer.name: Computer
Computer.flavorText: A computer that looks like it belongs in a laboratory. Some notes have been stuck to it here and there

Television.name: Television
Television.flavorText: A large television that can be easily viewed from far away. It's a flatscreen, so carrying it is easy-peasy.

Wall Monitor.name: Wall Monitor
Wall Monitor.flavorText: A monitor that emits blue light when powered on. Try displaying your photographs on it

Arcade Machine.name: Arcade Machine
Arcade Machine.flavorText: A game machine from a facility somewhere. It looks brand-new, so it probably can still be turned on

Game Boy System.name: Game Boy System
Game Boy System.flavorText: A very sturdy-looking game console. It's old but it still seems to start up

Humidifier.name: Humidifier
Humidifier.flavorText: A humidifier with a  distinct round shape. Turn it on to increase the humidity level nearby.

Jumbled Cords.name: Jumbled Cords
Jumbled Cords.flavorText: These cords are all tangled up and cannot be separated

Cd Player.name: Cd Player
Cd Player.flavorText: A device that plays music. If you find a CD, try putting it inside

Tabletop Mic.name: Tabletop Mic
Tabletop Mic.flavorText: A microphone like those used at recording studios or public speeches. Try putting it on a desk!

Standing Mic.name: Standing Mic
Standing Mic.flavorText: A microphone meant for the stage. Standing before it makes you want to burst into song

Cool Electric Guitar.name: Cool Electric Guitar
Cool Electric Guitar.flavorText: A snazzy guitat strung with strange strings. Holding it would make you feel pretty amped...

Cool Bass Guitar.name: Cool Bass Guitar
Cool Bass Guitar.flavorText: A snazzy bass guitar strung with strange strings. Holding it would make you feel pretty low-key...

Audio Mixer.name: Audio Mixer
Audio Mixer.flavorText: Plug it in and switch on the screen. DJ Ditto is in the house!

Speaker.name: Speaker
Speaker.flavorText: Putting this next to a stage or an audio mixer ought to create an electrifying atmosphere!

Ceiling Fan.name: Ceiling Fan
Ceiling Fan.flavorText: Its blades spin round and round when powered on. Great for when you want to circulate air!

Utility Pole.name: Utility Pole
Utility Pole.flavorText: Use these to connect electrical generators to machines and send electricity over long distances.

Wireless Power-transmitter Switch.name: Wireless Power-transmitter Switch
Wireless Power-transmitter Switch.flavorText: Connect these to electrical generators to use them. Put a switch nearby to quickly turn things on or off

Wireless Power Transmitter.name: Wireless Power Transmitter
Wireless Power Transmitter.flavorText: Use these to connect electrical generators to machines and send electricity over long distances.

Mini Generator.name: Mini Generator
Mini Generator.flavorText: Place this anywhere, and it will generate electricity all on its own. What a remarkable machine!

Floor Switch.name: Floor Switch
Floor Switch.flavorText: A ground-mounted switch that activates nearby machinery when it detects weight

Wall Switch.name: Wall Switch
Wall Switch.flavorText: A switch that would look perfect installed on a house wall. Press it to activate nearby devices

Card Reader.name: Card Reader
Card Reader.flavorText: A machine that reads key cards or Pokédexes. Mount it to a wall.

Laser Sensor.name: Laser Sensor
Laser Sensor.flavorText: When this sensor detects movement, it activates devices nearby

Security Camera.name: Security Camera
Security Camera.flavorText: A camera that watches over its surroundings. Place one anywhere you want to keep an eye on

Town Streetlight.name: Town Streetlight
Town Streetlight.flavorText: Power this with electricity to illuminate the area with gentle light

Harbor Streetlight.name: Harbor Streetlight
Harbor Streetlight.flavorText: A streetlight that invokes harbor vibes. The life buoy stands out as the main highlight.

Chic Streetlight.name: Chic Streetlight
Chic Streetlight.flavorText: When powered on, this light emits a gentle glow that faintly illuminates its surroundings

Double Streetlight.name: Double Streetlight
Double Streetlight.flavorText: When pwoered on, both lamps shine brightly to illuminate their surroundings

Mushroom Lamp.name: Mushroom Lamp
Mushroom Lamp.flavorText: The mushroom emits a gentle glow, illuminating the surroundings with soft light

Plain Lamp.name: Plain Lamp
Plain Lamp.flavorText: Powering this on illuminates the surroundings with warm light

Desk Light.name: Desk Light
Desk Light.flavorText: A light with a simple design. Perfect for brightening up your desk when you need to focus on work.

Poké Ball Light.name: Poké Ball Light
Poké Ball Light.flavorText: A neon light that glows red and white when powered on. It would look great on top of a table

Berry Table Lamp.name: Berry Table Lamp
Berry Table Lamp.flavorText: A Rawst Berry made of glass. Power it on to illuminate the area with pale blue light

Poké Ball Lamp.name: Poké Ball Lamp
Poké Ball Lamp.flavorText: Emits a brilliant light when powered on. This would look great on a shelf

Model Planet.name: Model Planet
Model Planet.flavorText: A model of some unexplored faraway planet. It looks jut like a piece of yummy candy

Red Meteor Lamp.name: Red Meteor Lamp
Red Meteor Lamp.flavorText: When powered on, this sparkles like a shooting star and instantly gives its surroundings a mystical vibe.

Luxury Lamp.name: Luxury Lamp
Luxury Lamp.flavorText: When this lamp is powered on, it emits a gentle light, illuminating its surroundings

Garden Light.name: Garden Light
Garden Light.flavorText: A light that's perfect for a garden. Beautifully illuminates flowers-even at night

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.flavorText: This emits bright light when powered on. You'll feel safe if you have this, even in a dark cave

Seedot Lamp.name: Seedot Lamp
Seedot Lamp.flavorText: When mounted to a wall, this looks just like a Seedot hanging from a branch!

Mirror Ball.name: Mirror Ball
Mirror Ball.flavorText: Sparkles and twinkles when powered on. Quickly turns the whole area into a party zone

Wall Light.name: Wall Light
Wall Light.flavorText: A light that can be fixed to a wall. Power it on and it'll light the area with a warm glow

Shell Lamp.name: Shell Lamp
Shell Lamp.flavorText: It looks like a simple seashell at first glance, but hang it up and power it on, and it emits a gentle light

Fluorescent Light.name: Fluorescent Light
Fluorescent Light.flavorText: Shines brilliantly when powered on. Even nighttime feels like noon when this light is on

Resort Light.name: Resort Light
Resort Light.flavorText: A light that resembles a ball of tangled string. Its gentle glow creates a fancy atmosphere

String Lights.name: String Lights
String Lights.flavorText: Hang these lights on the wall and power them on to create a lively atmosphere

Berry Hanging Lamp.name: Berry Hanging Lamp
Berry Hanging Lamp.flavorText: When hung from the ceiling and powered on, the tip of the Chesto Berry emits a gentle light

Surface Light.name: Surface Light
Surface Light.flavorText: Simple inconspicuous lights. You can embed them in ceilings and walls.

Spotlight.name: Spotlight
Spotlight.flavorText: When powered on, this light shines brightly on whatever is in front of it

Antique Chandelier.name: Antique Chandelier
Antique Chandelier.flavorText: Hang this from the ceiling to illuminate a room with gentle light. Perfeect for a mansion aesthetic!

Punching Bag.name: Punching Bag
Punching Bag.flavorText: Heavy and packed full of sand. Perfect for practicing punches and kicks!

Fluff.name: Fluff
Fluff.flavorText: An irresistibly soft tuft of fluff. Pokémon with the Litter specialty may scatter this

Resort Stool.name: Resort Stool
Resort Stool.flavorText: While this stool looks stiff, the cotton padding inside makes it surprisingly soft

Plain Chair.name: Plain Chair
Plain Chair.flavorText: This chair is just the right height for eating meals in the dining room

Resort Chair.name: Resort Chair
Resort Chair.flavorText: A chair perfect for relaxing. Kick back on this to taste a bit of the resort life

Plain Sofa.name: Plain Sofa
Plain Sofa.flavorText: If you see small Pokémon on this sofa, try sitting down next to them

Resort Sofa.name: Resort Sofa
Resort Sofa.flavorText: Sitting on this makes you feel like you're in the tropics! Feel free to just laze the day away...

Resort Bed.name: Resort Bed
Resort Bed.flavorText: A refreshingly cool bed made of woven vines. Lying down on this makes you feel like you're at a resort

Resort Hammock.name: Resort Hammock
Resort Hammock.flavorText: The breeze feels so nice when you're lying on this hammock. It's perfect for dozing off!

Nonburnable Garbage.name: Nonburnable Garbage
Nonburnable Garbage.flavorText: Trash discared here and there. Apparently some Pokémon are big fans of garbage

Wastepaper.name: Wastepaper
Wastepaper.flavorText: These look tough to craft in their current state. Try recycling them into regular paper

Garbage Bags.name: Garbage Bags
Garbage Bags.flavorText: Trash bags found most anywhere. Certain Pokémon find their odor irresistible

Nonburnable Garbage (outdoor).name: Nonburnable Garbage (outdoor)
Nonburnable Garbage (outdoor).flavorText: Obtained through a special method, thwese can be placed just as they are now

Crystal Ball.name: Crystal Ball
Crystal Ball.flavorText: A large crystal ball used for fortune-telling. Give it to a Psychic-type Pokémon and see what happens

Modern Door.name: Modern Door
Modern Door.flavorText: A simple yet sturdy door that would make the perfect entrance to a house

Glass Window.name: Glass Window
Glass Window.flavorText: A simple window that fits in any space. Arrange multiple vertically orhorizontally-your call.

Window Pane.name: Window Pane
Window Pane.flavorText: A framed glass pane. It makes a great window or partition

Stained-glass Window (upper).name: Stained-glass Window (upper)
Stained-glass Window (upper).flavorText: A fancy stained-glass window. It's got a slightly retro vibe.

Stained-glass Window (middle).name: Stained-glass Window (middle)
Stained-glass Window (middle).flavorText: A fancy stained-glass window. It's got a slightly retro vibe.

Stained-glass Window (lower).name: Stained-glass Window (lower)
Stained-glass Window (lower).flavorText: A fancy stained-glass window. It's got a slightly retro vibe.

Sash Window.name: Sash Window
Sash Window.flavorText: A long, vertical window with a cute cross trim. Try opening up the bottom half

Chic Sofa.name: Chic Sofa
Chic Sofa.flavorText: A luxurious high-class sofa. It looks exactly like the ones on the S.S. Anne

Antique Sofa.name: Antique Sofa
Antique Sofa.flavorText: A retro sofa with Poké Ball designs here and there

Iron Bench.name: Iron Bench
Iron Bench.flavorText: A seat made of solid hardened iron. It's sturdy enough to support even the heaviest Pokémon

Industrial Bench.name: Industrial Bench
Industrial Bench.flavorText: A simple bench made of wood and iron. The kind you'd expect to find at parks and walking paths.

Luxury Sofa.name: Luxury Sofa
Luxury Sofa.flavorText: This sofa is sooo fluffy. It's like sitting on a cloud

Garden Bench.name: Garden Bench
Garden Bench.flavorText: A stylish bench with a vine pattern. Put one down to instantly add some flair to an area

Pikachu Sofa.name: Pikachu Sofa
Pikachu Sofa.flavorText: Pikachu's face is front and center. On the back, you can find a little tail sticking out.

Wooden Bed.name: Wooden Bed
Wooden Bed.flavorText: This bed gives any room a mountain lodge aesthetic. You'll sleep soudnly surrounded by the woodsy scent

Guest-room Bed.name: Guest-room Bed
Guest-room Bed.flavorText: A bed with a rather high-class vibe. It looks like it belongs on a luxury ship or in a fancy hotel.

Antique Bed.name: Antique Bed
Antique Bed.flavorText: This bed has a relaxing, nostalgic atmosphere. The blanket is smooth to the touch

Industrial Bed.name: Industrial Bed
Industrial Bed.flavorText: A nice, wide bed that works in any type of room. Even a large Pokémon could sleep in it

Luxury Bed.name: Luxury Bed
Luxury Bed.flavorText: An extravagantly crafted bed. It somehow reminds you of a Luxury Ball!

Picnic Basket.name: Picnic Basket
Picnic Basket.flavorText: Try putting some food inside, and hungry Pokémon might stop by for a bite

Tea Set.name: Tea Set
Tea Set.flavorText: Enjoy an elegant teatime with this gorgeous set that includes a teapot and teacups

Table Setting.name: Table Setting
Table Setting.flavorText: This cutlery immediately makes any table look like it belongs in a high-class restaurant

Afternoon Tea Set.name: Afternoon Tea Set
Afternoon Tea Set.flavorText: Food loved by one of Eevee's friends. Be sure to prepare a table and chair too!

Bonfire.name: Bonfire
Bonfire.flavorText: When the wood in the center catches fire, this provides warmth and light to a large nearby area

Inflatable Boat.name: Inflatable Boat
Inflatable Boat.flavorText: Feels great whether you lie down on it like a bed, or float it on the water like a boat.

Stone.name: Stone
Stone.flavorText: Just a normal stone you can find anywhere. It can be used as a material for a lot of things

Iron Stand.name: Iron Stand
Iron Stand.flavorText: An impressively stury iron stand. Effortlessly supports even heavy items

Iron Table.name: Iron Table
Iron Table.flavorText: Iron-crafted with a simple design. This would work well in any sleekly stylish room

Iron Rack.name: Iron Rack
Iron Rack.flavorText: Decorate your space by putting your favorite things on these stackable shelves!

Stone Table.name: Stone Table
Stone Table.flavorText: A table made from stones. It's as hard as an Onix!

Stone Bench.name: Stone Bench
Stone Bench.flavorText: A wide, rock-solid seat. This would make a great park bench

Skull Fossil.name: Skull Fossil
Skull Fossil.flavorText: An ancient Pokémon fossil. It looks like a hard, sturdy skill

Armor Fossil.name: Armor Fossil
Armor Fossil.flavorText: An ancient Pokémon fossil. It looks like a smooth shield

Jaw Fossil.name: Jaw Fossil
Jaw Fossil.flavorText: An ancient Pokémon fossil. It looks like a large jaw

Sail Fossil.name: Sail Fossil
Sail Fossil.flavorText: An ancient Pokémon fossil. It looks like a thin sail from a Pokémon's body

Wing Fossil (right Wing).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's right wing. Its finger bones have become part of the wing

Wing Fossil (left Wing).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's left wing. By joining its bones together, you can tell the size of the wing

Wing Fossil (body).name: Wing Fossil (body)
Wing Fossil (body).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's body. A hump juts out from the middle of its rickety spine

Wing Fossil (tail).name: Wing Fossil (tail)
Wing Fossil (tail).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's tail. Long and slend, it looks like it could bend gracefully

Headbutt Fossil (head).name: Headbutt Fossil (head)
Headbutt Fossil (head).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's head. Its skull is dense and bulbous

Headbutt Fossil (body).name: Headbutt Fossil (body)
Headbutt Fossil (body).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's body. Its torso is big, but its arms are quite small

Headbutt Fossil (tail).name: Headbutt Fossil (tail)
Headbutt Fossil (tail).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's tail. Its base is thick and sturdy

Shield Fossil (head).name: Shield Fossil (head)
Shield Fossil (head).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's head. Its sturdy, like a giant shield

Shield Fossil (body).name: Shield Fossil (body)
Shield Fossil (body).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's body. Its thick bones supported a heavy head.

Shield Fossil (tail).name: Shield Fossil (tail)
Shield Fossil (tail).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's tail. Its hind hooves are particularly large.

Despot Fossil (head).name: Despot Fossil (head)
Despot Fossil (head).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's head. Its large fangs are as sharp as knives

Despot Fossil (body).name: Despot Fossil (body)
Despot Fossil (body).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's body. Its sharp claws look like they could slice through anything

Despot Fossil (legs).name: Despot Fossil (legs)
Despot Fossil (legs).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's legs. Two stocky legs support the rest of its body.

Despot Fossil (tail).name: Despot Fossil (tail)
Despot Fossil (tail).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's tail. Even the very tip is spiky like its frill

Tundra Fossil (head).name: Tundra Fossil (head)
Tundra Fossil (head).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's head. It has sails that resemble an aurora

Tundra Fossil (body).name: Tundra Fossil (body)
Tundra Fossil (body).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's body. It must have been pretty tall with a spin like this

Tundra Fossil (tail).name: Tundra Fossil (tail)
Tundra Fossil (tail).flavorText: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon's tail. The tip is curled up and looks like a spring

Stone Brick Wall.name: Stone Brick Wall
Stone Brick Wall.flavorText: Stone bricks that exude calmness. They're perfect for making buildings, flower beds, and such.

Stone Pillar (upper).name: Stone Pillar (upper)
Stone Pillar (upper).flavorText: A heavy stone pillar with a design that would pair nicely with a fancy brick wall

Stone Pillar (middle).name: Stone Pillar (middle)
Stone Pillar (middle).flavorText: A heavy stone pillar with a design that would pair nicely with a fancy brick wall

Stone Pillar (lower).name: Stone Pillar (lower)
Stone Pillar (lower).flavorText: A heavy stone pillar with a design that would pair nicely with a fancy brick wall

Stone Flooring.name: Stone Flooring
Stone Flooring.flavorText: Place these to create an entryway. Most folks won't notice if it gets a little dirty.

Stone Tiling.name: Stone Tiling
Stone Tiling.flavorText: Even rough, ordinary stones can be polished and stacked to make shiny tiles

Stone Steps.name: Stone Steps
Stone Steps.flavorText: Steps made of stacked stones. Place several of these for a stately atmosphere

Stone Hipped Roof.name: Stone Hipped Roof
Stone Hipped Roof.flavorText: You can arrange these vertically or horizontally to make a roof

Stone Roof Valley.name: Stone Roof Valley
Stone Roof Valley.flavorText: When you're planning out the shape of your roof, putting in some valleys adds a really nice touch

Stone Roof Decoration.name: Stone Roof Decoration
Stone Roof Decoration.flavorText: Try putting this on a roof! It looks great whether you install one or a whole bunch

Stone Fencing.name: Stone Fencing
Stone Fencing.flavorText: Looks great on its own or arranged in a row.

Stone Debris.name: Stone Debris
Stone Debris.flavorText: Sometimes found blocking the road. Break them to obtain stones.Note: Not registered in collection

Metal Debris.name: Metal Debris
Metal Debris.flavorText: It's hard to tell what these warn out objects were originally. They look difficult to process as is.Note: Not registered in collection

First Aid Kit.name: First Aid Kit
First Aid Kit.flavorText: A box with lots of medicines and supplies for treating injuries

Letter.name: Letter
Letter.flavorText: A simple sealed letter. It has a Poké Ball stamp on it

Notepad.name: Notepad
Notepad.flavorText: It's full of important-looking notes, so there's no space to write anything else!

Open Book.name: Open Book
Open Book.flavorText: A classic hardcover book. It's probably got a lot of difficult words inside

Papers.name: Papers
Papers.flavorText: Lots of tiny words are written on the white pages along with drawings of colorful shapes

Newspaper.name: Newspaper
Newspaper.flavorText: Its pages are filled with small, tightly-packed letters. What could be written here?

Information Board.name: Information Board
Information Board.flavorText: A sign with information about the town written on it. Nobody knows what town it's for, though.

Berry Table.name: Berry Table
Berry Table.flavorText: A large Aspear Berry table. It looks real enough to make you want to bite into it.

Berry Chair.name: Berry Chair
Berry Chair.flavorText: When placed on the ground, it looks just like a buried Leppa Berry. The steam and leaves are a backrest.

Berry Basket.name: Berry Basket
Berry Basket.flavorText: A basket packed with berries. Line up a few to make your very own fruit stand!

Berry Clock.name: Berry Clock
Berry Clock.flavorText: A clock that resembles an Oran Berry cross section. Try mounting it on a wall

Berry Wall Decoration.name: Berry Wall Decoration
Berry Wall Decoration.flavorText: The six swaying berries look incredibly tasty. Alas, they're inedible

Berry Print (wallpaper).name: Berry Print (wallpaper)
Berry Print (wallpaper).flavorText: Wallpaper that can be used in larger houses. You can appliy it to walls, floors and even ceilings

Berry Print.name: Berry Print
Berry Print.flavorText: Sweeyt berries, spicy berries, bitter berries... This pattern has berry flavors for everyone

Mud.name: Mud
Mud.flavorText: A mass of muddy debris. Spray it with Bubble to clean it up!Note: Not registered in collection

Campfire.name: Campfire
Campfire.flavorText: A campfire made from gathered sticks. When lit, it illuminates the area with a warm light.

Torch.name: Torch
Torch.flavorText: If you light this, it'll burn slowly, filling the area with bright light

Slender Candle.name: Slender Candle
Slender Candle.flavorText: Light this up to get a flickering bright-red flame. It's small enough to fit on a desk

Eerie Candle.name: Eerie Candle
Eerie Candle.flavorText: Fwoosh! This candle glows with a bluish flame when lit. It's small enough to fit on top of a desk.

Wall Torch.name: Wall Torch
Wall Torch.flavorText: A simple light that looks appropriate even on rugged surfaces such as caves and rock walls

Firepit.name: Firepit
Firepit.flavorText: Set this ablaze to illuminate the surroundings with bright light. Fwoosh!

Straw Table.name: Straw Table
Straw Table.flavorText: Table may be an overly generous description of this big slab of stone atop a pile of hay

Log Table.name: Log Table
Log Table.flavorText: With just some cutting and sanding, you can turn logs into a proper table

Garden Table.name: Garden Table
Garden Table.flavorText: A stylish table that would look nice with a garden chair or two

Log Chair.name: Log Chair
Log Chair.flavorText: You can sit on this log to take a quick breather. Other Pokémon might stop by to take a break too.

Garden Chair.name: Garden Chair
Garden Chair.flavorText: A chair that would be perfect in a nice garden. Take a seat and enjoy an elegant afternoon.

Log Bed.name: Log Bed
Log Bed.flavorText: A bed made from small logs. You'll sleep soundly enveloped by a woodsy aroma

Straw Bed.name: Straw Bed
Straw Bed.flavorText: It's a little itchy, but that doesn't bother Pokémon. They'll snooze away just fine on this.

Modern Sink.name: Modern Sink
Modern Sink.flavorText: A state-of-the-art sink that even has a drain. Turn the handle to make water flow out

Sink.name: Sink
Sink.flavorText: A stylish sink on a wooden stand. Turn on the faucet to make water pour out.

Beach Parasol.name: Beach Parasol
Beach Parasol.flavorText: Place one of these on the beach for protection from scorching sunbeams

Horsea Fountain.name: Horsea Fountain
Horsea Fountain.flavorText: Installing this near water should raise the humidity of its surroundings

Fishing Rod.name: Fishing Rod
Fishing Rod.flavorText: A must-have item for fishing up Pokémon. Set one by the water and wait patiently for a bite!

Mystic Water.name: Mystic Water
Mystic Water.flavorText: A teardrop-shaped gem. Try hanging it up in a frame!

Antique Table.name: Antique Table
Antique Table.flavorText: Its lumpy legs are cute. You can make a large table by arranging several of these together

Chic Table.name: Chic Table
Chic Table.flavorText: A table that would look right at home in a facny restaurant. Perfect for a decadent dinner

Luxury Table.name: Luxury Table
Luxury Table.flavorText: An extravagant marble table. Setting one down brings elegance to any room.

Chic Chair.name: Chic Chair
Chic Chair.flavorText: A luxurious loung chair. Sitting on its soft cushions is absolutely beyond compare!

Antique Chair.name: Antique Chair
Antique Chair.flavorText: A chair with a charming retro design. Its cushions are soft and fluffy

Luxury Chair.name: Luxury Chair
Luxury Chair.flavorText: A classy-looking seat with a gemstone embedded in it. Just sitting on it makes you feel rich.

Antique Dresser.name: Antique Dresser
Antique Dresser.flavorText: Look into the mirror to change your transformation and perfect your look!

Luxury Dresser.name: Luxury Dresser
Luxury Dresser.flavorText: Look into the mirror to change your transformation and perfect your look!

Fancy Pen.name: Fancy Pen
Fancy Pen.flavorText: A high-class ballpoint pen that exudes luxury. A very important person could have used this

Copper Ore.name: Copper Ore
Copper Ore.flavorText: Raw mineral copper. When processed into ingots, it can be used as a crafting material

Iron Ore.name: Iron Ore
Iron Ore.flavorText: Metal that can be obtained from iron deposits. It can also be found among metal debris

Gold Ore.name: Gold Ore
Gold Ore.flavorText: Metal extracted from gold deposits. It glitters with a luxurious sheen

Pokémetal Fragment.name: Pokémetal Fragment
Pokémetal Fragment.flavorText: Colorful, sparkling metal extracted from Pokémetal deposits.

Rare Pokémetal Fragment.name: Rare Pokémetal Fragment
Rare Pokémetal Fragment.flavorText: This can sometimes be found in Pokémetal deposits. If you find one, consider yourself extremely lucky!

Copper Ingot.name: Copper Ingot
Copper Ingot.flavorText: Copper that has been processed in a smelting furnace. It kinda looks like chocolate...

Iron Ingot.name: Iron Ingot
Iron Ingot.flavorText: Iron that has been processed in a smelting furnace. It's really hard and super heavy.

Gold Ingot.name: Gold Ingot
Gold Ingot.flavorText: Gold that has been processed in a smelting furnace. Just looking at it makes you feel fancy

Industrial Desk.name: Industrial Desk
Industrial Desk.flavorText: A desk with a beautifuly wood grain texture. This would even look great outside the house.

Office Desk.name: Office Desk
Office Desk.flavorText: A desk often used in offices. The pull-out drawer is locked and won't open.

Iron Chair.name: Iron Chair
Iron Chair.flavorText: Though small, this seat is very sturdy. It doesn't look like it would break easily.

Iron Bed.name: Iron Bed
Iron Bed.flavorText: A slightly narrow bed. It's sturdy enough for a good night's sleep!

Funky Diffuser.name: Funky Diffuser
Funky Diffuser.flavorText: The symbol on it looks dangerous, but it doesn't seem like this will actually spew out poison gas...

Fire Hydrant.name: Fire Hydrant
Fire Hydrant.flavorText: This device spews water for putting out fires, but you're not really sure how to use it,...

Iron-plate Flooring (wallpaper).flavorText: Wallpaper that can be used in larger houses. You can appliy it to walls, floors and even ceilings

Iron Wall.flavorText: A solid iron wlal. It gives off a slight sheen when it's exposed to light.

Iron-plate Flooring.name: Iron-plate Flooring
Iron-plate Flooring.flavorText: Iron-plate flooring that looks like it belongs in a factory. Steel-type Pokémon might enjoy this.

Iron Deposit.name: Iron Deposit

Iron Steps.name: Iron Steps
Iron Steps.flavorText: Steps that wouldn't look out of place in a factory. They're a bit bumpy, which helps prevent slipping

Iron Ladder.name: Iron Ladder
Iron Ladder.flavorText: Great for reaching high places. Connect them vertically, then climb straight up

Metal Chain.name: Metal Chain
Metal Chain.flavorText: A thin, sturdy chain. Link a few pieces together and you can use them to climb up to high places

Iron Door.name: Iron Door
Iron Door.flavorText: A door with an antique pattern carved onto it. Would pair well with gorgeous furniture

Iron Gate.name: Iron Gate
Iron Gate.flavorText: Fancy double doors with a whirling patten. It would pair nicely with some metal fencing

Iron Enclosure.name: Iron Enclosure
Iron Enclosure.flavorText: A single post may be thin and flimsy, but these make a splendid fence when lined up together

Metal Fencing.name: Metal Fencing
Metal Fencing.flavorText: Looks great on its own or arranged in a row.

Iron Beam.name: Iron Beam
Iron Beam.flavorText: These solid, sturdy beams can be used to support floors and roofs.

Iron Column.name: Iron Column
Iron Column.flavorText: Stack these up to form a proper iron pillar!

Iron Pillar.name: Iron Pillar
Iron Pillar.flavorText: Stack as many as you'd like for a taller pillar. The top platform looks like it can display small items

Sandbox.flavorText: Place this to set up a fun space for playing with sand. Discover what you can create here!

Tire Toy.flavorText: Tires used in parks as playground equipment. Put them on the ground and have fun hopping over them!

Slide.flavorText: An essential part of any playground. Its imposing size leaves a real impression

Small Vase.flavorText: A vase with a single cute flower inside. Put it anywhere to add a splash of color to your life

Mysterious Goggles.name: Mysterious Goggles
Mysterious Goggles.flavorText: Goggles with mysterious power. Wearing these allows you to peek into someone's cloud island

Side Table.name: Side Table
Side Table.flavorText: A side table with a refreshing appearance. It'd be perfect next to a beach chair.

Wooden Table.name: Wooden Table
Wooden Table.flavorText: You only need lumber to make this. Despite its small size, it's still a splendid table

Counter.name: Counter
Counter.flavorText: Line up these counters to make them longer. You can also rotate a few to make some nice corners

Wall-mounted Table.name: Wall-mounted Table
Wall-mounted Table.flavorText: A superb table that can fit snugly in a corner. A row of them would also make a great countertop

Pokémon Center Counter.name: Pokémon Center Counter
Pokémon Center Counter.flavorText: Line these up to make a Pokémon Center countertop. They have a simple, clean design

Kitchen Table.name: Kitchen Table
Kitchen Table.flavorText: A glossy table that protects against grime. It would look great placed near a sink and stove

Push Cart.name: Push Cart
Push Cart.flavorText: A table cart. Try putting stuff on top of it, like food

Exhibition Stand.name: Exhibition Stand
Exhibition Stand.flavorText: You can place these side by side to adjust the size. Try displaying lots of different things on top!

Mysterious Pedestal.name: Mysterious Pedestal
Mysterious Pedestal.flavorText: Looks like it originally had something on top of it...

Resort Table.name: Resort Table
Resort Table.flavorText: This table is made of resilient material and perfectly safe to keep outside, even in rain or a squall.

Poké Ball Table.name: Poké Ball Table
Poké Ball Table.flavorText: A round table that looks like a Poké Ball. It's large enough to carry lots of stuff.

Office Table.name: Office Table
Office Table.flavorText: You can see through the glass surface. If you drop anything underneath it, you'll notice right away

Avalugg Table.name: Avalugg Table
Avalugg Table.flavorText: A solid table with cracks in it. It looks just like a resting Avalugg

Straw Stool.name: Straw Stool
Straw Stool.flavorText: This is the perfect size for small Pokémon to take a seat!

Simple Cushion.name: Simple Cushion
Simple Cushion.flavorText: A simple practical cusion. It's filled with cotton and provides a soft seat.

Plain Stool.name: Plain Stool
Plain Stool.flavorText: A stool with a simple design. Small Pokémon can use this as a seat

Industrial Chair.name: Industrial Chair
Industrial Chair.flavorText: A perfectly round chair that can easily fit anywhere. Surprisingly sturdy, thanks to its iron legs.

Waterproof Seat.name: Waterproof Seat
Waterproof Seat.flavorText: A smooth waterproof chair. Place it near a bathtub or shower

Wooden Stool.name: Wooden Stool
Wooden Stool.flavorText: It's a little chipped but surprisingly sturdyy. Even if a Pokémon sits on it, it won't break. Probably.

Public Seat.name: Public Seat
Public Seat.flavorText: A simple chair without a backrest. Try arranging a bunch of 'em together

Soft Seat.name: Soft Seat
Soft Seat.flavorText: A cushioned seat that's soft and fluffy-perfect for waiting rooms, relaxation spaces, and the like!

Box Sofa.name: Box Sofa
Box Sofa.flavorText: A small square sofa. Line up several of them to make a wide chic sofa

Fancy Chair.name: Fancy Chair
Fancy Chair.flavorText: A high-class chair with a real dignified feel to it. Just sitting here will make you feel important.

Spectator Chair.name: Spectator Chair
Spectator Chair.flavorText: Audience seats like those are found at concert halls or stadiums. Try arranging a bunch of 'em in a row!

Folding Chair.name: Folding Chair
Folding Chair.flavorText: A foldable chair that's simple and easy to carry. Set these up at event venues or similar spaces!

Office Chair.name: Office Chair
Office Chair.flavorText: With a gentle curve to support the body, this chair was designed to help you sit longer without tiring

Wooden Bench.name: Wooden Bench
Wooden Bench.flavorText: A long bench that's perfect for taking a break. Pokémon might sit next to each other here.

Poké Ball Sofa.name: Poké Ball Sofa
Poké Ball Sofa.flavorText: Experience sitting in an open Poké Ball! Seats two comfortably

Naptime Bed.name: Naptime Bed
Naptime Bed.flavorText: Kick back right on top of Snorlax's belly. It feels so comfy you could snooze through the whole day

Wall Mirror.name: Wall Mirror
Wall Mirror.flavorText: Look into the mirror to change your transformation and perfect your look!

Large Mirror.name: Large Mirror

Wiggly Mirror.name: Wiggly Mirror
Wiggly Mirror.flavorText: Look into the mirror to change your transformation and perfect your look!

Wooden Plate.name: Wooden Plate
Wooden Plate.flavorText: If you put some food on this plate, Pokémon might stop by to eat.

Plate.name: Plate
Plate.flavorText: Dishware made from fired clay. A Pokémon might eat food served on it.

Offering Dish.name: Offering Dish
Offering Dish.flavorText: Try placing food in this platter as an offering to Mosslax!

Party Platter.name: Party Platter
Party Platter.flavorText: A plate for serving party food. No sneaking a taste before the party starts, though!

Paper Party Cups.name: Paper Party Cups
Paper Party Cups.flavorText: Paper cups that are easy to carry- perfect for hosting a party!

Pitcher-plant Pot.flavorText: A flower vase with a pink lip that resembles a Pokémon's mouth. It emanates a faintly sweet aroma

Small Garbage Can.name: Small Garbage Can
Small Garbage Can.flavorText: A simple, colorful trash can, perfect for indoor use

Pencil Holder.name: Pencil Holder
Pencil Holder.flavorText: A pencil holder with lots of poencils in it. Try putting this on top of a study desk

Book.name: Book
Book.flavorText: A thick hardcover book. The pages inside were written in small print

Book Pile.name: Book Pile
Book Pile.flavorText: A pile of upturned books with torn-out pages. They look like they fell off from a bookshelf

Photo Frame.name: Photo Frame
Photo Frame.flavorText: You can put one of your photos in this frame and place it on a table or stand

Wall Photo Frame.name: Wall Photo Frame
Wall Photo Frame.flavorText: You can put one of your photos in this frame and hang it on a wall.

Corkboard.name: Corkboard
Corkboard.flavorText: Choose one of your favorite photos to hang on this corkboard!

Cooking Stove.name: Cooking Stove
Cooking Stove.flavorText: A simple stylish stove. Turn the dial and flames will shoot right out of it

Towel Rack.name: Towel Rack
Towel Rack.flavorText: A simple wall rack with a towel hanging on it. This would look great next to a sink

Microscope.name: Microscope
Microscope.flavorText: A microscope often found in chemistry labs and research institutions. Essential for experiments!

Science Experiment.name: Science Experiment
Science Experiment.flavorText: Chemicals, testing equipment, and a clipboard... OK! The experiment is ready to begin!

Big Drum.name: Big Drum
Big Drum.flavorText: A very impessive drum. Beat it to produce a loud, invigorating da-a-DUM!

Punching Game.name: Punching Game
Punching Game.flavorText: Slug this machine real good with your first, and it'll tell you how strong your punch is

Step Stool.name: Step Stool
Step Stool.flavorText: A step stool for reaching things in high places. Try climbing on top of it.

Whiteboard.name: Whiteboard
Whiteboard.flavorText: A whiteboard covered in writing and sticky notes that looks like it belongs in a lab

Control Unit.name: Control Unit
Control Unit.flavorText: This has a bunch of switches, but it doesn't look like any of them do anything

Ship's Wheel.name: Ship's Wheel
Ship's Wheel.flavorText: A wheel used to steer a ship. It spinds round and round when you touch it!

Gym Emblem Statue.name: Gym Emblem Statue
Gym Emblem Statue.flavorText: This stone statue makes you feel pumped up. Would look great on a pedestal

Spacesuit.name: Spacesuit
Spacesuit.flavorText: Clothing designed for living in outer space. Keeps the wearer safe even in an airless environment

Wall Calendar.name: Wall Calendar
Wall Calendar.flavorText: A calendar that's simple and easy to use. It meshes well with pretty much any wall.

Decorative Bookshelf.name: Decorative Bookshelf
Decorative Bookshelf.flavorText: A decorative shelf with colorful books on it. Perfect for livening up any wall!

Decorative Storage Shelf.name: Decorative Storage Shelf
Decorative Storage Shelf.flavorText: A decorative shelf lined with ceramic bottles. Attach it to a wall to liven up any space!

Decorative Plant Shelf.name: Decorative Plant Shelf
Decorative Plant Shelf.flavorText: A long vine droops from the potted plant on this decorative shelf. Perfect for livening up any wall!

Rowlet Clock.name: Rowlet Clock
Rowlet Clock.flavorText: A wall clock shaped like a small house. Rowlet will pop out to let you know what time it is

Hanging Banner.name: Hanging Banner
Hanging Banner.flavorText: Cloth you might find on a department store's wall. Stack several to make 'em even longer

Party Bunting.name: Party Bunting
Party Bunting.flavorText: These make perfect party decorations. Hang a bunch to create a festive mood!

Hanging Scroll.name: Hanging Scroll
Hanging Scroll.flavorText: A scrol with phenomenal brushwork. Hang it on a wall to create a solemn atmosphere

Castform Weather Charm.name: Castform Weather Charm
Castform Weather Charm.flavorText: A reversible Castform doll. Rumor has it, when the doll changes form, the weather changes too!

Grubby Letter.name: Grubby Letter
Grubby Letter.flavorText: A yellowed letter, still sealed. It's got a postage stamp with a Poké Ball pattern on it.

Grubby Notepad.name: Grubby Notepad
Grubby Notepad.flavorText: It looks like there's some pretty important stuff written on this, but it's a little grimy

Grubby Papers.name: Grubby Papers
Grubby Papers.flavorText: Lots of tiny words are written on the yellowed pages along with drawings of colorful shapess.

Grubby Newspaper.name: Grubby Newspaper
Grubby Newspaper.flavorText: A newspaper with noticeable dirt and grime. It smells like old paper

Grubby Tablet.name: Grubby Tablet
Grubby Tablet.flavorText: A convenient, easy-to-carry deivce. Even though it's inside a hard case, the screen is cracked

Grubby Cell Phone.name: Grubby Cell Phone
Grubby Cell Phone.flavorText: A device with a cracked screen. It can't make any calls, even when powered on.

Wall-mounted Flowers.name: Wall-mounted Flowers
Wall-mounted Flowers.flavorText: A planter with colorful flowers. Hang one on a wall to create a vibrant space.

Chansey Plant.name: Chansey Plant
Chansey Plant.flavorText: A tree that looks just like a Chansey! Looking at it seems to fill you with a gentle energy

Bike.name: Bike
Bike.flavorText: A cool bicycle that looks high-end. It sparkles as if it's brand-new

Planter.name: Planter
Planter.flavorText: Plant some flower or vegetable seeds here, and raise them until they're fully grown.

Cart.name: Cart
Cart.flavorText: It has a large bed, so it looks like you can use it to haul some pretty big stuff.

Perch.name: Perch
Perch.flavorText: A branch perch where bird Pokémon can rest. Place a few and you might get some visitors.

Wooden Birdhouse.name: Wooden Birdhouse
Wooden Birdhouse.flavorText: A birdhouse filled with dry, soft grass. Bird Pokémon would probably love lounging here.

Mailbox.name: Mailbox
Mailbox.flavorText: A box for receiving letters. It'd look really nice in front of a house!

Weather Vane.name: Weather Vane
Weather Vane.flavorText: A decoration that spins around and around in the wind. Looks like a bird Pokémon perched on a post.

Cannon.name: Cannon
Cannon.flavorText: Put fireworks or a Pokémon with the Explode specialty inside, light the fuse, and watch 'em fly!

Bell.name: Bell
Bell.flavorText: A golden, wall-mounted bell. When struck, it rings with a pleasant sound.

Small Stage.name: Small Stage
Small Stage.flavorText: Get on and start dancing! You can power on the lights by hooking this up to electricity

Hot-spring Spout.name: Hot-spring Spout
Hot-spring Spout.flavorText: Place this next to a pool of hot water to create a genuine hot-spring vibe

Canoe.name: Canoe
Canoe.flavorText: A paddle, bucket and rope is all you need for a journey out to sea

Menu Board.name: Menu Board
Menu Board.flavorText: Specials are written on this board, but it doesn't seem like Pokémon can actually read them.

Raichu Sign.name: Raichu Sign
Raichu Sign.flavorText: A sign depicting Raichu discharging electricity. When powered up, the neon lighting glows brightly

Photo Cutout Board.name: Photo Cutout Board
Photo Cutout Board.flavorText: Put your fac through the hole to become Plusle or Minun!

Barrel.name: Barrel
Barrel.flavorText: It's totally empty inside. You could put something on top to make it look nice

Recycling Bin.name: Recycling Bin
Recycling Bin.flavorText: A bin for disposing of empty cans. It's just big enough for a Pokémon to fit inside

Grubby Rags.name: Grubby Rags
Grubby Rags.flavorText: A piece of tattered cloth unsuitable for processing. Cut it up to obtain twine.

Traffic Cone.name: Traffic Cone
Traffic Cone.flavorText: When lined up, the cones are connected by barrier poles. Great for construction zones!

Sewer-hole Cover.name: Sewer-hole Cover
Sewer-hole Cover.flavorText: A sewer-hole cover that opens like a door. It can serve as an entrance  if you put it on top of a hole

Excavation Tools.name: Excavation Tools
Excavation Tools.flavorText: A sturdy-looking pickax and shovel. They're wasted on any Pokémon who can already dig, though.

Tires.name: Tires
Tires.flavorText: This tire stack looks like it could collapse at any moment, but oddly enough it stays upright

Heat Rock.name: Heat Rock
Heat Rock.flavorText: A mysterious rock that radiates heat. Place it to raise the temperature around it.

Icy Rock.name: Icy Rock
Icy Rock.flavorText: A mysterious rock that radiates cold. Place it to lower the temperature around it.

Smooth Rock.name: Smooth Rock
Smooth Rock.flavorText: A mysterious rock that feels smooth. Place it to lower the humidity of the surrounding area.

Damp Rock.name: Damp Rock
Damp Rock.flavorText: A mysterious rock that feels damp. Place it to raise the humidity of the surrounding area.

Ditto Flag.name: Ditto Flag
Ditto Flag.flavorText: A flag that marks Ditto's house. Place it on a house you want to live in.

Workbench.name: Workbench
Workbench.flavorText: Try gathering lots of materials and making a variety of different things here!

Community Box.name: Community Box
Community Box.flavorText: Pokémon can deposit items they've stumbled upon into this box or take items out to process them

Frying Pan.name: Frying Pan
Frying Pan.flavorText: Kitchen equipment for making hamburger steak. Put this on a stove or campfire

Stylish Frying Pan.name: Stylish Frying Pan
Stylish Frying Pan.flavorText: Kitchen equipment for making hamburger steak. Put this on a stove or campfire

Cooking Pot.name: Cooking Pot
Cooking Pot.flavorText: Kitchen equipment for making soup. Put this on a stove or campfire

Stylish Cooking Pot.name: Stylish Cooking Pot
Stylish Cooking Pot.flavorText: Kitchen equipment for making soup. Put this on a stove or campfire

Bread Oven.name: Bread Oven
Bread Oven.flavorText: Kitchen equipment for baking bread. Have a Pokémon light the fire for you.

Smelting Furnace.name: Smelting Furnace
Smelting Furnace.flavorText: A furnace for processing ore into metals. Get a Pokémon with the Burn specialty to help you out

Metallic Smelting Furnace.name: Metallic Smelting Furnace
Metallic Smelting Furnace.flavorText: A high-performance metallic furnace that can quickly process metals and other ingredients

Concrete Mixer.name: Concrete Mixer
Concrete Mixer.flavorText: A Pokémon with the Crush specialty can use this to make concrete out of water and stone

Railway Track.name: Railway Track
Railway Track.flavorText: Lay down tracks to create a railway, then ride a handcar to get where you're going in a jiffy!

Crossing Gate.name: Crossing Gate
Crossing Gate.flavorText: With its characteristic black-and-yellow lines, this can be used to designate loading zones for a handcard

Elevator Platform.name: Elevator Platform
Elevator Platform.flavorText: You can make a functional elevator by using ladders to vertically connect two elevator platforms

Lift Platform.name: Lift Platform
Lift Platform.flavorText: Place two of these with enough distance between them to create an automatic transport system

Cash Register.name: Cash Register
Cash Register.flavorText: Place this on a table and power it on, and Pokémon will come by to conduct trades!

Sprinkler.name: Sprinkler
Sprinkler.flavorText: An irrigation device that sprays water in a wide area. Try putting one near the waterside

Mini Floodgate.name: Mini Floodgate
Mini Floodgate.flavorText: Turn the handle on top to start or stop the flow of water

Leppa Seeds.flavorText: Seeds that grow into Leppa trees. Try planting them in some soil

Chesto Seeds.name: Chesto Seeds
Chesto Seeds.flavorText: Seeds that grow into Chesto trees. Try planting them in some soil

Wheat Seeds.flavorText: Seeds that grow into wheat. Try planting them in a field.

Potato Seeds.name: Potato Seeds
Potato Seeds.flavorText: Seeds that grow into poatoes. Try planting them in a field

Tall Grass.name: Tall Grass
Tall Grass.flavorText: Grass that smells faintly of soil. It looks perfect for Pokémon to hide in

Yellow Tall Grass.name: Yellow Tall Grass
Yellow Tall Grass.flavorText: Grass that often grows by the seaside. It has a bright, tropical color.

Red Tall Grass.name: Red Tall Grass
Red Tall Grass.flavorText: Grass that grows far and wide, even on volcanoes or tall mountains. Its tips are as red as lava.

Pink Tall Grass.name: Pink Tall Grass
Pink Tall Grass.flavorText: Grass that paints the surface of the skylands pink with its floral hue

Green Shoots.name: Green Shoots
Green Shoots.flavorText: Small, sparsely grown plants that stand strong no matter how much you walk on them

Wooden Wall.name: Wooden Wall
Wooden Wall.flavorText: Line up a bunch of these to build a wall. They give off a faint but pleasant woodsy aroma

Light Wooden Wall.name: Light Wooden Wall
Light Wooden Wall.flavorText: Line up a bunch of these to build a wall. The wood grain pops more than a regular wooden wall's

Painted Wall.name: Painted Wall
Painted Wall.flavorText: While the planks of this wall have been painted over, a closer inspection reveals they're a little dirty

Plaster Wall.name: Plaster Wall
Plaster Wall.flavorText: Gather some shells, crush them up, and compact them to make the perfect wall of gritty plaster

Cloth Wall.name: Cloth Wall
Cloth Wall.flavorText: Simple cloth walls. Try them out in interior spaces

Guest-room Wall.name: Guest-room Wall
Guest-room Wall.flavorText: Made from the same material as cloth walls, this was used for the guest rooms of a luxury cruise ship

Starry-sky Wall.name: Starry-sky Wall
Starry-sky Wall.flavorText: These stars shine even in the dark. Stack them up to create a night sky filled wiith stars

Cushy Wall.name: Cushy Wall
Cushy Wall.flavorText: An exceptionally shiny wall that feels very high-class. Pairs wonderfully with luxury furniture items

Modern Wall.name: Modern Wall
Modern Wall.flavorText: When cut into pieces and arranged, even rugged rocks can be transformed into a stylish wall.

Broken-tiling Wall.name: Broken-tiling Wall
Broken-tiling Wall.flavorText: A wall made up of shattered tiles. It shines like glass when the light hits it

Cobblestone Wall.name: Cobblestone Wall
Cobblestone Wall.flavorText: A tightly packed mass of stones of various sizes. Perfect for stacking as well as making walls

Brick Wall.name: Brick Wall
Brick Wall.flavorText: These really stand out when stacked up. Use them to make eye-catching buildings

Aged-stone Wall.name: Aged-stone Wall
Aged-stone Wall.flavorText: It's chipped in places and the colors have faded, revealing a glimpse of its long history

Patterned Aged-stone Wall.name: Patterned Aged-stone Wall
Patterned Aged-stone Wall.flavorText: It's got some cracks running through it, but its triangular pattern remains as it was long ago

Concrete Wall.name: Concrete Wall
Concrete Wall.flavorText: Doesn't this sorta remind you of Conkeldurr's concrete pillars?

Rough Wall.name: Rough Wall
Rough Wall.flavorText: A wall made of concrete. Gives a slightly more chic impression than plaster.

Striped Wall.name: Striped Wall
Striped Wall.flavorText: A sharp, stylish wall. Made of sturdy copper, it's perfect for a warehouse

Bronze Wall.name: Bronze Wall
Bronze Wall.flavorText: A metal wall with a reddish-brown shine to it. It looks like a big piece of chocolate when stacked up

Stylish Bronze Wall.name: Stylish Bronze Wall
Stylish Bronze Wall.flavorText: A metal wall with ornate designs on it. Arrange some of these to create a rich and opulent space.

Stylish Iron Wall.name: Stylish Iron Wall
Stylish Iron Wall.flavorText: A fancy wall made of iron. It provides a nice accent when paired with a regular iron wall

Gold Wall.name: Gold Wall
Gold Wall.flavorText: Pure sparkling gold. It's as dazzling as Gholdengo

Stylish Gold Wall.name: Stylish Gold Wall
Stylish Gold Wall.flavorText: A golden wall with high-quality stones set in it. This one detail gives it an air of refined elegance

Crystal Wall.name: Crystal Wall
Crystal Wall.flavorText: A wall that sparkles in the light. It's made of crystal and quite hard

Poké Ball Wall.name: Poké Ball Wall
Poké Ball Wall.flavorText: The white Poké Ball pattern on this wall is always nice and shiny

Warning Wall.name: Warning Wall
Warning Wall.flavorText: Warns of danger with its yellow and black stripes. Maybe you could use it to mark areas off-limits

Wooden Flooring.name: Wooden Flooring
Wooden Flooring.flavorText: Flooring composed of hard, tightly aligned wooden planks. It can support a heavy Pokémon. Probably.

Diagonal Wooden Flooring.name: Diagonal Wooden Flooring
Diagonal Wooden Flooring.flavorText: Place these down to use them as flooring. Their simple design goes with pretty much anything

Crisscross Wooden Flooring.name: Crisscross Wooden Flooring
Crisscross Wooden Flooring.flavorText: Place these side by side to form a stylish alternating pattern that's perfect for a café floor. How chic!

Hardwood Flooring.name: Hardwood Flooring
Hardwood Flooring.flavorText: Flooring made from arranged pieces of sanded lumber

Modern Carpeting.name: Modern Carpeting
Modern Carpeting.flavorText: Soft, fluffy carpeting. It would look nice in a modern building

Woven Carpeting.name: Woven Carpeting
Woven Carpeting.flavorText: Carpeting that can be found in offices. Place them next to eachother to form a checkerboard pattern.

Fluffy Flooring.name: Fluffy Flooring
Fluffy Flooring.flavorText: Moderately soft cotton flooring. It probably wouldn't hurt if you fell on it.

Soft Carpeting.name: Soft Carpeting
Soft Carpeting.flavorText: Fluffy carpeting that feels as soft as a cloud. Place a bunch together for a really nice look!

Extravagant Carpeting.name: Extravagant Carpeting
Extravagant Carpeting.flavorText: Walking on this high-class embroidered carpeting makes you feel like a star.

Tatami Mat.name: Tatami Mat
Tatami Mat.flavorText: Tatami mat flooring often found in traditional homes. You can make this by weaving leaves together

Felt Mat.name: Felt Mat
Felt Mat.flavorText: Often used for carpeting. Felt can be laid out as floring or stacked up into décor

Puffy-tree Pillar.name: Puffy-tree Pillar
Puffy-tree Pillar.flavorText: These may look like a big tree when stacked up... but they're actually cushions stuffed with leaves

Grass Flooring.name: Grass Flooring
Grass Flooring.flavorText: This looks like real grass, but it's actually made of cushions

Simple Flooring.name: Simple Flooring
Simple Flooring.flavorText: Flooring made by polished hewn stone. It's glossy and hard to the touch.

Marble.name: Marble
Marble.flavorText: Lay down some of this beautifully patterned marble and enjoy a taste of the rich life.

Lined-stone Flooring.name: Lined-stone Flooring
Lined-stone Flooring.flavorText: Provides a lovely accent when paired with stone flooring

Dark Marble Flooring.name: Dark Marble Flooring
Dark Marble Flooring.flavorText: Stylish flooring with a dark brown trim. It's perfect for museums and the like.

Light Marble Flooring.name: Light Marble Flooring
Light Marble Flooring.flavorText: Stylish flooring with a light gray trim. Perfect for offices and the like

Aged-stone Flooring.name: Aged-stone Flooring
Aged-stone Flooring.flavorText: Stone flooring found in ancient ruins. There's something mysterious about its triangular pattern

Simple Square Tiling.name: Simple Square Tiling
Simple Square Tiling.flavorText: These smooth, water-repellant tiles would make a great bathroom wall.

Stylish Tiling.name: Stylish Tiling
Stylish Tiling.flavorText: Glossy cermaic tiles that could be used for walls or flooring.

Hexagonal Flooring.name: Hexagonal Flooring
Hexagonal Flooring.flavorText: Lifeless flooring with a hexagonal pattern. Perfectly suited for high-tech places such as laboratories

Shop Flooring.name: Shop Flooring
Shop Flooring.flavorText: Flooring that reminds you of shop floors. Try installing a counter and cash register!

Triangle-design Flooring.name: Triangle-design Flooring
Triangle-design Flooring.flavorText: Shiny flooring with a vibrant, triangular pattern. Make this using Pokémetal!

Iron Tiling.name: Iron Tiling
Iron Tiling.flavorText: Install these on the floor to create a stylish industrial vibe, like the inside of a warehouse

Neon Flooring.name: Neon Flooring
Neon Flooring.flavorText: Line these up to make a brightly lit floor. You'll feel like you've wandered into a neon universe

Cyber Flooring.name: Cyber Flooring
Cyber Flooring.flavorText: The edges are constantly glowing. Arrange them side by side to create a futuristic atmosphere

Arched Tiling.name: Arched Tiling
Arched Tiling.flavorText: Each one alone is just an ordinary brick. But placed together, they make a beautiful arching pattern.

Square Tiling.name: Square Tiling
Square Tiling.flavorText: Tiles often found in seaside towns. They have a distinct, slightly rough texture

Mosaic Tiling.name: Mosaic Tiling
Mosaic Tiling.flavorText: Colorfully patterned tile flooring. Set up a fewe blocks to create a metropolitan atmosphere

Brick Flooring.name: Brick Flooring
Brick Flooring.flavorText: Vivid bricks that remind you of sunny days. Walking along these makes you feel quite cheeful

Stylish Stone Flooring.name: Stylish Stone Flooring
Stylish Stone Flooring.flavorText: It's just a bunch of stones piled up-and yet it somehow looks stylish

Fish-scale Tiling.name: Fish-scale Tiling
Fish-scale Tiling.flavorText: Stone tiles in a beautiful fish-scale pattern

Asphalt Road.name: Asphalt Road
Asphalt Road.flavorText: Pave the way for Pokémon to have nice roads that are easy to walk on

Marked Road (horizontal).name: Marked Road (horizontal)
Marked Road (horizontal).flavorText: Asphalt road with a white line on it. Arrange these in a row to make a crosswalk

Marked Road (vertical).name: Marked Road (vertical)
Marked Road (vertical).flavorText: Asphalt road with a white line on it. Arrange these in a row to make a crosswalk

Gray Circle Flooring.name: Gray Circle Flooring
Gray Circle Flooring.flavorText: The prominent gray circle looks like the perfect spot to install a utility pole

Hay Pile.name: Hay Pile
Hay Pile.flavorText: Bales of straw can be arranged to make walls or flooring, whichever you choose

Iron Plating.name: Iron Plating
Iron Plating.flavorText: Sturdy plating that's even used to make ships. Change its color to your liking

Cube Light.name: Cube Light
Cube Light.flavorText: A cube that's constantly emitting bright light, even without electricity. It's made from shining rocks

Foundation.name: Foundation
Foundation.flavorText: A sturdy foundation made of firmly bonded stone and concrete

Levee.name: Levee
Levee.flavorText: Place these wherever you want to stop the flow of water. Sturdy enough to hold back rivers and oceans

Scrap Cube.name: Scrap Cube
Scrap Cube.flavorText: A block of condensed cloth and scrap metal. It looks like it was made by a Pokémon skilled at crafting

Polka-dot Print.name: Polka-dot Print
Polka-dot Print.flavorText: This pop-art polka-dot pattern looks cute whether you line up a bunch or use some as an accent

Bubble Print.name: Bubble Print
Bubble Print.flavorText: A pattern with lots of floating bubbles. It has a unique ephemeral charm to it

Vertical-stripe Print.name: Vertical-stripe Print
Vertical-stripe Print.flavorText: Vertical stripes like those on Flaaffy's tail. This simple pattern looks like it'd fit in a variety of places.

Horizontal-stripe Print.name: Horizontal-stripe Print
Horizontal-stripe Print.flavorText: Horizontal stripes like those on Elekid. This simple pattern looks like it'd fit in a variety of places.

Gingham Print.name: Gingham Print
Gingham Print.flavorText: A checkered pattern with a white base. A classic, simple design

Tartan Print.name: Tartan Print
Tartan Print.flavorText: a checkered pattern with several colors. The design is both methodical and adorable

Argyle Print.name: Argyle Print
Argyle Print.flavorText: A diamond-shaped checkered pattern. It has a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Houndstooth Print.name: Houndstooth Print
Houndstooth Print.flavorText: If you stare at this pattern for a long time, you just might see a flock of flying bird Pokémon

Vine Print.name: Vine Print
Vine Print.flavorText: This twisting, twirling pattern is fully interconnected. It kind of resembles Serperior's patterning

Swirl Print.name: Swirl Print
Swirl Print.flavorText: Straight lines that bend and contort into spirals. Staring at this will make your eyes spiral too!

Winter Print.name: Winter Print
Winter Print.flavorText: A pattern with a snowflake motif. Perfect for colder seasons.

Zig-zag Print.name: Zig-zag Print
Zig-zag Print.flavorText: A cool pattern that zigzags like Pikachu's tail

Leaf Print.name: Leaf Print
Leaf Print.flavorText: This leaf pattern is easy on the yes and makes you feel like you're in a forest - perfect for relaxation!

Flower Print.name: Flower Print
Flower Print.flavorText: A floral pattern with lots of cute flowers. You'll feel like you're on a picnic every time you look at it.

Star Print.name: Star Print
Star Print.flavorText: A pattern with stars of all sizes. Use it for your floor or walls so you can reach out and touch the stars.

Curry Print.name: Curry Print
Curry Print.flavorText: A pattern with a delicious-looking curry motif, packed full of savory vegetable flavor.

Poké Ball Print.name: Poké Ball Print
Poké Ball Print.flavorText: A pattern with lots of different-color Poké Balls. It has a cute, pop-art feel to it

Stylish Poké Ball Print.name: Stylish Poké Ball Print
Stylish Poké Ball Print.flavorText: A pattern with a fancy Poké Ball design. It'd look great in any sort of upscale house

Field Grass.name: Field Grass
Field Grass.flavorText: Soft soil with grass growing on top. It's perfect for planting  tree or flower seeds.

Seashore Grass.name: Seashore Grass
Seashore Grass.flavorText: Coastal soil with thin grass growing out of it. If you use Leafage on this, tall yellow grass will grow

Alpine Grass.name: Alpine Grass
Alpine Grass.flavorText: Dark-green grass often found in valleys

Sky-high Grass.name: Sky-high Grass
Sky-high Grass.flavorText: Lush, green grass that grows in white soil.

Ordinary Soil.name: Ordinary Soil
Ordinary Soil.flavorText: Regular old soil that's a bit soft. If you use Leafage on it, green tall grass will grow

Seashell Soil.name: Seashell Soil
Seashell Soil.flavorText: Despite the seashells mixed into it, this soil is softer than sand and capable of supporting plant life

Striped Soil.name: Striped Soil
Striped Soil.flavorText: Soil made up of layers of sediment from volcanic eruptions that accumulated and hardened over time

Pure-white Soil.name: Pure-white Soil
Pure-white Soil.flavorText: White soil with a touch of colorful sand mixed in. Often found in the skylands.

Clay.name: Clay
Clay.flavorText: Soft enough for you to leave your footprints on it. It's actually made up of tiny grainds of sand!

Ordinary Sand.name: Ordinary Sand
Ordinary Sand.flavorText: Ordinary sand that can be found all over. There's some moisture in it, but it's hardened up a little

Beach Sand.name: Beach Sand
Beach Sand.flavorText: Fine sand found on the beach. If you build a castle out of this, it probably wouldn't collapse.

Skyland Sand.name: Skyland Sand
Skyland Sand.flavorText: Silky sand found at the skylands. It's lighter in color than ordinary sand

Bumpy Beach Sand.name: Bumpy Beach Sand
Bumpy Beach Sand.flavorText: sand with various stones and small seashells packed within. Stepping on it leaves footprints behind

Volcanic Ash.name: Volcanic Ash
Volcanic Ash.flavorText: Ash that fell from the sky after a volcanic eruption

Sandstone.name: Sandstone
Sandstone.flavorText: Amassed sand, left alone for countless years, has slowly hardened into stone

Skyland Sandstone.name: Skyland Sandstone
Skyland Sandstone.flavorText: Over the course of many years, the sand from the skylands has hardened into rock

Cliff Rock.name: Cliff Rock
Cliff Rock.flavorText: A type of rock often found on mountain cliffs. Looks like you could break it with Rock Smash

Spotted Cliff Rock.name: Spotted Cliff Rock
Spotted Cliff Rock.flavorText: Small rocks from the distant past, often found in valleys, that have hardened over time into stratum

Red Cliff Rock.name: Red Cliff Rock
Red Cliff Rock.flavorText: Red rock that looks like it came from a steep mountainside cliff.

Red Spotted Cliff Rock.name: Red Spotted Cliff Rock
Red Spotted Cliff Rock.flavorText: Boulders often seen by the seaside. With the waves at their backs, they stand tall, powerful and majestic

Black Cliff Rock.name: Black Cliff Rock
Black Cliff Rock.flavorText: Black rock that looks like it came from a steep mountainside cliff.

Black Spotted Cliff Rock.name: Black Spotted Cliff Rock
Black Spotted Cliff Rock.flavorText: It's rough and bumpy because it's packed with small rocks. It has a weighty, imposing presence.

Skyland Cliff Rock.name: Skyland Cliff Rock
Skyland Cliff Rock.flavorText: A type of rock that towers over all on mountain slopes. It can only be found at the skylands

Skyland Spotted Cliff Rock.name: Skyland Spotted Cliff Rock
Skyland Spotted Cliff Rock.flavorText: Lots of tiny stones are crammed in between skyland cliff rocks, giving them a rugged look

White Rock.name: White Rock
White Rock.flavorText: A pale, slightly hard rock that is tough to break
